scope: Property-initiated runtime traffic and user-triggered external navigation; this inventory does not authorize network traffic during functional tests

destinations.destination: Six bundled wss relay URLs or relay URLs explicitly saved by the user; ws is allowed only for localhost tests.
destinations.trigger: App startup after identity activation, explicit relay changes, or event publication/subscription.
destinations.data_exposure: The selected relay can observe the connecting IP and public event metadata; private NIP-17 bodies remain encrypted.
destinations.offline_test_rule: Replace bundled endpoints with local isolated relays and deny all external egress.

destinations.traffic: browser HTTPS GET to selected relay origin
destinations.destination: HTTPS origin derived from a user-selected WSS relay for NIP-11 metadata.
destinations.trigger: The user opens the relevant community/relay information flow.
destinations.data_exposure: The relay host receives a metadata request; request uses no credentials and no referrer.
destinations.offline_test_rule: Use local HTTP/HTTPS stubs inside the isolated namespace; no public relay request.

destinations.traffic: browser HTTPS GET to identity's claimed domain
destinations.destination: https://<domain>/.well-known/nostr.json, where the domain comes from the identifier being checked.
destinations.data_exposure: The domain sees a public-key lookup and connecting IP; the result verifies only a published mapping, not a real-world person.
destinations.offline_test_rule: Inject a local fetch stub and reject network egress.

destinations.traffic: browser HTTPS GET to GitHub API
destinations.trigger: Explicit verification of a GitHub NIP-39 claim.
destinations.data_exposure: GitHub receives the public gist identifier and connecting IP; content is treated as untrusted proof data.
destinations.offline_test_rule: Inject a local fetch stub; never access the public API in functional tests.

destinations.traffic: browser HTTPS GET to Bluesky public API
destinations.trigger: Explicit verification of a Bluesky NIP-39 claim.
destinations.data_exposure: The API receives a public actor/post lookup and connecting IP; returned data is not an executable source.
destinations.offline_test_rule: Inject a local fetch stub; never access the public API in functional tests.

destinations.traffic: WebRTC ICE/STUN/TURN for direct calls and file transfer
destinations.destination: Default Google STUN hosts; user-configured STUN/TURN endpoints are also supported.
destinations.trigger: An explicitly initiated direct call or peer file transfer.
destinations.data_exposure: ICE servers and peers can observe network addresses needed for connectivity; user TURN credentials are local configuration.
destinations.offline_test_rule: Stub RTCPeerConnection/ICE in automated fixtures; no external STUN/TURN calls.

destinations.traffic: browser fetch of same-origin PWA resources
destinations.destination: The origin hosting the static Property shell and its packaged assets.
destinations.trigger: Initial page load, service-worker install/update, or a missing cached resource.
destinations.data_exposure: The static host receives normal web request metadata; no executable source is intentionally loaded from a third-party CDN.
destinations.offline_test_rule: Serve the full local bundle and deny all egress; fail on any undeclared origin.

destinations.traffic: browser fetch of local emoji dataset
destinations.destination: A JSON dataset packaged under the same PWA origin.
destinations.trigger: The user opens the emoji picker.
destinations.data_exposure: No third-party request is needed for the dataset.
destinations.offline_test_rule: Serve the packaged data locally with egress blocked.

destinations.traffic: browser HTTPS GET to a public URL in a draft message
destinations.destination: The HTTPS origin of the link being previewed; private, local, credentialed, and non-HTTPS targets are rejected by the parser.
destinations.trigger: The enabled link-preview feature inspects a URL while composing a private message; the preview is sent only if the person includes it.
destinations.data_exposure: The target host can observe the browser IP and that the URL was fetched; request has no credentials or referrer and HTML is bounded and parsed as data, never executed.
destinations.offline_test_rule: Inject a local fetch stub for a reserved test hostname and deny all egress.

destinations.destination: OpenStreetMap page for coordinates in a location card.
destinations.trigger: The user explicitly opens the map link.
destinations.data_exposure: The map host receives coordinates and connecting IP; map tiles are not loaded in the Property app before the action.
destinations.offline_test_rule: Assert link construction only; do not navigate outside the local test origin.

destinations.traffic: MCP agent process WebSocket to Nostr relays
destinations.destination: Relays explicitly configured for the agent identity.
destinations.trigger: An MCP tool or local agent action publishes/subscribes to Nostr.
destinations.data_exposure: Relay observes agent public key, IP, event metadata, and ciphertext; private content remains encrypted.
destinations.offline_test_rule: Point only to isolated local relay endpoints and block external egress.

destinations.traffic: MCP agent HTTP request to authenticated Nano gateway
destinations.destination: HTTP loopback only (127.0.0.0/8 or ::1); the client rejects non-loopback and non-HTTP URLs.
destinations.trigger: An explicitly configured and locally budgeted XNO agent payment action.
destinations.data_exposure: Local authenticated wallet gateway receives a bounded RPC action; credentials are not sent to a remote host.
destinations.offline_test_rule: Use a private local Nano dev node and authenticated loopback gateway; no mainnet.

destinations.destination: The relay binds to 127.0.0.1:7447 by default; operator may deliberately configure a public bind.
destinations.trigger: The relay operator starts the bundled Geode process.
destinations.data_exposure: A public relay stores/serves its configured event data and may observe connecting client IPs; public exposure requires operator TLS/network policy.
destinations.offline_test_rule: Bind all relays to isolated loopback/container addresses and block external egress.

destinations.destination: The campaign engine itself has no fixed external endpoint; deployment-specific BTC/XMR/XNO adapters supply local wallet/node RPC endpoints.
destinations.trigger: Relay operator invokes a campaign payment decision or reconciliation.
destinations.data_exposure: Configured wallet/node receives the payment lookup or return request; exact endpoint and authentication belong to the injected adapter and require per-currency audit.
destinations.offline_test_rule: Use isolated private local wallet/node RPCs only; missing endpoint classification fails closed.

destinations.traffic: Agent MCP wallet and trade adapter JSON-RPC requests
destinations.destination: HTTP loopback only (127.0.0.0/8 or ::1); the agent client rejects non-loopback and non-HTTP URLs.
destinations.trigger: An explicit local wallet, trade, or payment-observation action by the agent.
destinations.data_exposure: The configured local Bitcoin, Monero, or Nano node/wallet receives bounded RPC requests; credentials remain local and are sent only to loopback.
destinations.offline_test_rule: Use private local wallet/node RPC fixtures only; do not use mainnet or external endpoints.
